scope: Direct source scan of all finance page.tsx routes; advisory proposals, not runtime proof

proposal.title: 1099 preparation
proposal.layout: Vendor eligibility/data quality, year/type totals, generated batches and validation results.
proposal.workflow: Replace native alerts/confirm; identify applicable filing year/format and require authorized submission separately.
proposal.proof: Prove missing vendor fields, thresholds from effective policy, corrected return linkage and actual file schema.

proposal.title: GL to subledger reconciliation
proposal.layout: As-of account comparison with signed GL/subledger/difference and evidence detail.
proposal.workflow: Do not use absolute value for signed balances or turn load errors into empty success.
proposal.proof: Prove negative differences remain negative, as-of/book scope matches and variance drill-through explains residuals.

proposal.title: Accounting books and mappings
proposal.layout: Book list/detail with basis, currency, effective period and mapping-rule table.
proposal.workflow: Replace native dialogs; show source/destination accounts by name; preview mapping impact and unmapped accounts.
proposal.proof: Prove same-book invalid mapping, missing accounts, effective dates, signed multiplier and controlled deletion.

proposal.title: Financial analytical assistance
proposal.layout: Forecast/anomaly run list with source scope, model/version, assumptions and review.
proposal.workflow: Label predictions and uncertainty; show evidence and human decision, never autonomous posting or invented certainty.
proposal.proof: Prove data availability, reproducible run metadata, reviewer feedback, permission scope and safe failure.

proposal.title: Allocation rules and runs
proposal.layout: Rule register, source-pool/driver setup, allocation preview and run history.
proposal.workflow: Expose basis, dimensions, effective date, rounding remainder and destination accounts using lookups.
proposal.proof: Prove allocated total equals source pool, zero denominator, missing driver, replay and journal lineage.

proposal.title: AP scheduling and payment runs
proposal.layout: Schedules/run queue with due date, bank account, amount, status and exceptions.
proposal.workflow: Separate proposal, approval, execution and settlement; expose failed items rather than single success toast.
proposal.proof: Prove duplicate-run protection, approval expiry, funds/currency constraints and item-level retry.

proposal.title: Invoice matching rules
proposal.layout: Rule table with supplier/category scope, quantity/price tolerance and effective dates.
proposal.workflow: Replace terse edit/delete with impact-aware operations; simulate against example bill lines before activating.
proposal.proof: Prove overlapping rule precedence, unauthorized tolerance changes and auditable version activation.

proposal.title: AR aging analysis
proposal.layout: As-of customer/invoice aging matrix with open balance and dispute drill-down.
proposal.workflow: One aging bucket definition and currency policy shared with AR overview and exports.
proposal.proof: Prove exact boundary days, credits/partial payments, as-of allocation and aggregate reconciliation.

proposal.title: Collections and dunning automation
proposal.layout: Dunning levels, eligibility preview, run history and exclusion controls.
proposal.workflow: Separate rule setup from outbound execution; preview recipients/content and respect holds/disputes.
proposal.proof: Prove no unauthorized sends, duplicate-run prevention, exclusion reasons and delivery outcomes.

proposal.title: Advanced asset operations
proposal.layout: Operation sections and run history over owned asset contracts.
proposal.workflow: Preserve specialized operation inputs; review selection, effective date, valuation and required approval.
proposal.proof: Prove multi-asset partial outcomes, tenant scope, idempotency and lifecycle-specific accounting evidence.

proposal.title: Finance audit and control evidence
proposal.layout: Searchable audit stream and explicitly separate SOX rules/conflicts sections.
proposal.workflow: Page name must match actual controls surface; show actor/action/record/time/outcome and resolution history.
proposal.proof: Prove read-only audit integrity, redaction, bounded export, filter persistence and permission-controlled conflict resolution.

proposal.title: Bank account master
proposal.layout: Masked account register/detail with entity, currency, ledger mapping, status and reconciliation setup.
proposal.workflow: Use verified reference lookups; expose ownership and change approval without leaking full sensitive identifiers.
proposal.proof: Prove invalid mapping, duplicate identity, role restriction, masking and historical transaction compatibility.

proposal.title: Bank feed connections and import
proposal.layout: Connection health, sync history, statement import preview and transaction list.
proposal.workflow: Show provider/source, last successful sync, reauthorization, duplication and mapping errors; never fabricate credentials.
proposal.proof: Prove malformed file/duplicate import, connection expiry, retry idempotency and no secret exposure.

proposal.title: Transaction matching
proposal.layout: Two-sided statement/ledger workspace with amount/date/reference candidates and residuals.
proposal.workflow: Replace raw entity-ID input with authorized search; explain suggestion and allow deliberate manual match.
proposal.proof: Prove ambiguous matches, signed amounts, split residual, already-matched conflict and foreign ID denial.

proposal.title: Budget scenarios
proposal.layout: Scenario register with baseline/version, assumptions, owner and comparison action.
proposal.workflow: Meaningful scenario names and clone provenance; delete draft only under policy.
proposal.proof: Prove scenario isolation, base preservation, permission and saved comparison state.

proposal.title: Budget versions and control
proposal.layout: Budget register/detail, actual comparison, reallocations and setup sections.
proposal.workflow: Separate approved baseline, working draft and transfer approval; clear version owner and currency.
proposal.proof: Prove line totals, budget control, reallocation balancing, amendment history and concurrent edit conflict.

proposal.title: Cash forecast
proposal.layout: Time-bucket cash forecast grid with scenario, inflow/outflow category and variance.
proposal.workflow: Replace native alerts; distinguish actuals, committed items, assumptions and manual overrides with audit.
proposal.proof: Prove opening-to-closing roll-forward, missing rate/data, horizon changes and persisted overrides.

proposal.title: Cash position
proposal.layout: Daily account/entity/currency position with available/restricted balances and source timestamp.
proposal.workflow: Separate baseline from stress simulation, and expose assumptions and actual conversion rates.
proposal.proof: Prove multi-currency totals, stale accounts, restricted cash definition and reset without altering actual balances.

proposal.title: Chart of accounts
proposal.layout: Hierarchical account register with code, type, parent, posting eligibility and activity.
proposal.workflow: Support actual hierarchy and real account lookup; normalize Income/REVENUE terminology by owning contract.
proposal.proof: Prove cycles/duplicate codes rejected, posted-account deletion restrictions and account-to-ledger drill-down.

proposal.title: Close management calendar
proposal.layout: Schedule/calendar plus dependencies, SLA policies, deadlines, breaches and task inspector.
proposal.workflow: Preserve existing specialized contracts; show immutable SLA provenance and task-specific amendments distinctly.
proposal.proof: Prove dependency cycles/cross-tenant edges rejected, calendar timezone, SLA pagination and audited assignment.

proposal.title: Close task register
proposal.layout: Period-filtered tasks with assignee, due time, dependency, evidence and status.
proposal.workflow: Task generation uses real template/version; bulk changes show selected scope and blocked tasks.
proposal.proof: Prove only eligible tasks complete, dependency enforcement, permission checks and persisted evidence.

proposal.title: Group consolidation
proposal.layout: Entity/book/period scope, mapping and translation checks, run status and consolidated statements.
proposal.workflow: Expose ownership percentages/translation rules only from approved policy; block missing mappings.
proposal.proof: Prove subsidiary-to-group roll-up, elimination reconciliation, run version and partial failure recovery.

proposal.title: Card controls detail
proposal.layout: RecordShell: card overview, limits, scoped rules, transactions and audit.
proposal.workflow: Replace scope-ID textbox with permitted entity/team/category lookup; show effective dates and inherited limits.
proposal.proof: Prove invalid/foreign scope, concurrent policy edit, spend-limit precedence and audit trail.

titles: Manage corporate credit cards, monthly spend caps, and department budget limits.

proposal.title: Corporate card register
proposal.layout: Masked cards by holder/team, currency, limit, spend and connection status.
proposal.workflow: Distinguish feed ingestion from issuing/freezing a card; meaningful authorized detail routes.
proposal.proof: Prove masked data, currency-aware utilization, unavailable feed and permission-limited controls.

proposal.title: Customer credit controls
proposal.layout: Exposure register with limit, utilization, aging, hold reason and history.
proposal.workflow: Replace alert/confirm; justify credit/hold changes with authority, effective date and evidence.
proposal.proof: Prove currency-consistent exposure, limit threshold, expiry, concurrent updates and downstream hold enforcement.

proposal.title: Currency revaluation compatibility workspace
proposal.layout: Comparison of current route semantics with FX runs and exposed currencies/books.
proposal.workflow: Keep separate only if distinct domain purpose; otherwise documented alias to accepted canonical workflow.
proposal.proof: Prove no duplicate run across entry points and preserve existing links and supported contract behavior.

proposal.title: Customer statements
proposal.layout: Customer/date/currency selector and opening/activity/closing statement preview.
proposal.workflow: Create accessible actual document with payments/credits and source references; authorized delivery separate.
proposal.proof: Prove opening plus activity equals closing, privacy scope, period selection and actual output format.

proposal.title: Electronic invoice exchange
proposal.layout: Document/status register with network/jurisdiction, validation and acknowledgment history.
proposal.workflow: Separate generated, submitted, rejected and accepted; preserve provider response and correction route.
proposal.proof: Prove schema validation, provider failure, duplicate transmission and secure acknowledgment lineage.

proposal.title: ESG accounting evidence
proposal.layout: Emissions/activity, factor version, offsets and KPI register with scope/units/source.
proposal.workflow: Distinguish measurement, estimation and assurance; never mix offsets with gross emissions silently.
proposal.proof: Prove unit conversion, factor effective date, duplicate activity and transparent net/gross reconciliation.

proposal.title: AP exceptions
proposal.layout: Exception-first worklist with category, amount, age, owner and resolution options.
proposal.workflow: Provide actual source mismatch evidence and controlled reasoned resolution, not arbitrary status edit.
proposal.proof: Prove duplicate resolution, reopened exceptions, required evidence and no bypass of payment approval.

proposal.title: Exchange rates
proposal.layout: Base/quote/type/date/source register with effective ranges and approval.
proposal.workflow: Distinguish spot/closing/average; show import source and stale/missing status rather than static USD format.
proposal.proof: Prove inverted pairs, zero/negative rates, duplicate effective keys and approval history.

proposal.title: Expense policy and rates
proposal.layout: Policy/category, mileage and per-diem tables with jurisdiction/currency/effective dates.
proposal.workflow: Explain precedence, exception approvals and inherited settings; preview change impact.
proposal.proof: Prove overlapping date/rate rules, historical reimbursement invariance and unauthorized policy denial.

proposal.title: Expense reports
proposal.layout: Submitter/report register plus line/receipt detail, policy exceptions and approval history.
proposal.workflow: Separate submit, approve, reject and reimburse; OCR is extraction evidence rather than approval.
proposal.proof: Prove missing receipt, policy violation, currency conversion, duplicate expense and reimbursement replay.

proposal.title: Instrument accounting
proposal.layout: Instrument records with valuation date, model inputs, fair value and credit-loss evidence.
proposal.workflow: Keep valuation/provisioning workflows distinct from trade execution; show method/version and sensitivity.
proposal.proof: Prove stale inputs, sign/currency/precision, approval and resulting accounting record lineage.

proposal.title: Financial periods
proposal.layout: Fiscal calendar/register showing book/entity, open/closing/closed and allowed actions.
proposal.workflow: Move actual close/reopen here under explicit control, never cosmetic shell status change.
proposal.proof: Prove overlapping periods, posting cutoff, close blockers, role denial and audited reopening.

proposal.title: Financial ratios
proposal.layout: Defined ratio cards/table with numerator, denominator, units, baseline and source links.
proposal.workflow: Remove implied health benchmarks unless sourced/configured; show N/A for undefined ratios.
proposal.proof: Prove zero/negative denominator policy, period comparability and exact underlying statement values.

proposal.title: Asset lifecycle record
proposal.layout: RecordShell: acquisition, books, schedule, transfers, impairment/disposal and audit.
proposal.workflow: Explain each permitted transition and accounting impact; schedule belongs to selected book/date.
proposal.proof: Prove disposed asset controls, transfer history, impairment approval and value-to-journal reconciliation.

proposal.title: New asset record
proposal.layout: Acquisition/capitalization form with source document, cost/currency and depreciation policy.
proposal.workflow: Use real categories/accounts and explicit in-service/residual/life inputs; no sample defaults.
proposal.proof: Prove residual versus cost, date ordering, required mapping, failed save retention and durable creation.

proposal.title: Asset records
proposal.layout: Searchable category/location/custodian/lifecycle register with book values and currency.
proposal.workflow: Share record identities and depreciation source with core assets; detail/new links are canonical.
proposal.proof: Prove filter/sort/page totals, disposed/held assets, deep links and selected export scope.

proposal.title: Asset categories and overview
proposal.layout: Asset workspace with category/setup section and link to full asset records.
proposal.workflow: Clarify overview versus record register; canonical category, depreciation and account mappings.
proposal.proof: Prove category mapping validity, no duplicate master source and actual register totals.

proposal.title: Rolling forecasts
proposal.layout: Forecast version/horizon register and driver/actual overlay.
proposal.workflow: Distinguish rolling forecast from annual budget; show actual cutoff, forecast horizon and assumptions.
proposal.proof: Prove period roll-forward, overwritten actual prevention, refresh conflict and persisted scenario lineage.

proposal.title: FX revaluation runs
proposal.layout: Run list plus context/rate preview wizard and detail journal links.
proposal.workflow: Handle actual source/target currency, exclusions and gain/loss sign; canonical owner shared with core FX.
proposal.proof: Prove supported currencies, stale rate rejection, posting/reversal linkage and idempotent run.

proposal.title: Elimination ledger/rules/runs
proposal.layout: Consolidation-period rule matrix, preview and resulting journal list.
proposal.workflow: Show elimination basis and unmapped counterpart exceptions; separate proposed from posted entries.
proposal.proof: Prove group/book scope, residual reconciliation, replay and actual reversal history.

proposal.title: Netting runs
proposal.layout: Eligible obligations, entity-pair balances, proposal and settlement status.
proposal.workflow: Show gross to net calculation, currency/rate/date and excluded disputed items before approval.
proposal.proof: Prove net totals, duplicate inclusion, multi-currency policy and partial settlement reconciliation.

titles: Manage multi-entity intercompany loan agreements, management fees, and consolidation elimination entries.

proposal.title: Intercompany transaction register
proposal.layout: Entity-pair/document/status register with due-to/due-from, currency and agreement.
proposal.workflow: Distinguish loans/fees/trade entries and netting/elimination links; no direct cross-entity mutation from UI.
proposal.proof: Prove reciprocal source references, allowed entity scope, balanced accounting and exception resolution.

proposal.title: Invoice analysis
proposal.layout: Metrics and cohort/aging analysis with definitions, filters and drill-through.
proposal.workflow: Separate issued, recognized and collected revenue; expose source period and data coverage.
proposal.proof: Prove filtered totals match invoices, no double counting, zero denominator and chart accessible table.

proposal.title: Supplier invoice capture
proposal.layout: Document upload/preview beside extracted header and line fields.
proposal.workflow: Use real extraction provenance/confidence and field corrections; duplicate check before draft creation.
proposal.proof: Prove unreadable document, unsupported type, tax/total mismatch, upload failure and retained human corrections.

proposal.title: New journal
proposal.layout: TransactionWorkspace with header context, editable line grid, totals and validation summary.
proposal.workflow: Replace generic flat form if it cannot represent complete balanced lines; blank amounts and draft default.
proposal.proof: Prove at least two valid lines, precision, no simultaneous debit/credit misuse, dirty exit and server validation.

proposal.title: Advanced journal register
proposal.layout: Canonical journal lifecycle list with totals and next permitted actions.
proposal.workflow: Map basic and advanced implementations to one authoritative journal model; preserve supported aliases.
proposal.proof: Prove list/detail/create continuity, approval/post separation and source-document navigation.

proposal.title: Lease detail
proposal.layout: RecordShell with payment schedule, liability/ROU roll-forward, amendments and audit.
proposal.workflow: Compare before/after remeasurement and disclose effective date; preserve original assumptions.
proposal.proof: Prove modified payment schedule, termination accounting, replay and journal references under owned policy.

proposal.title: New lease
proposal.layout: Structured term/payment/discount-rate form with schedule preview and basis.
proposal.workflow: Explain units/rate frequency/options; save draft before recognition; use authorized counterparties/accounts.
proposal.proof: Prove irregular payments, date/rate validity, rounding and server-owned schedule calculation.

proposal.title: Lease register
proposal.layout: Lessor/asset/classification/currency/term register with liability and ROU balances.
proposal.workflow: State accounting basis and calculation date; remeasurement is controlled versioned amendment.
proposal.proof: Prove active/terminated classification, schedule totals and lease-to-journal drill-through.

proposal.title: Finance workspace catalog
proposal.layout: Searchable permission-aware categorized links with consistent names and descriptions.
proposal.workflow: Derive reachability/counts from one registry; explain task rather than claiming broad capability or readiness.
proposal.proof: Prove no dead links, denied-workspace filtering, accurate counts and distinct tab identity for all entries.

proposal.title: Payment batches
proposal.layout: Batch composer with eligible bills, selected totals, deductions, bank/value date and review.
proposal.workflow: Use durable proposal ID/version; removal changes draft only; no accidental live payment on selection.
proposal.proof: Prove partial failure, replay, duplicate bill selection, concurrent settlement and per-item results.

proposal.title: Payment terms master
proposal.layout: Terms register with due-date calculation, discount window and active/effective state.
proposal.workflow: Preview due date from sample business date using configured calendar; avoid ambiguous free text only.
proposal.proof: Prove month-end/leap-year rules, inactive-term usage and historical document preservation.

proposal.title: Reconciliation certification
proposal.layout: Account/statement/period reconciliation register with difference and supporting evidence.
proposal.workflow: Separate suggested match, matched lines and signed-off reconciliation; canonical book and statement sources.
proposal.proof: Prove opening plus movements equals closing, unresolved items disclosed and actual certification audit.

proposal.title: Recurring invoices
proposal.layout: Schedule register with customer/template/cadence/effective dates and generated documents.
proposal.workflow: Use one schedule owner shared with core recurring page; explicit preview/pause/resume and generation result.
proposal.proof: Prove missed-run catch-up policy, month-end cadence, idempotency and no duplicate invoices.

proposal.title: Statement suite
proposal.layout: Statement selector and dimensions with period comparisons and account drill-through.
proposal.workflow: Share report execution/export semantics with core reports; preserve book and basis context.
proposal.proof: Prove P&L/BS/cash-flow/trial-balance identities, filters, missing mappings and reproducible output.

proposal.title: Revenue recognition
proposal.layout: Contract/performance obligation schedule with recognized/deferred balances by period.
proposal.workflow: Explain recognition basis and proposed journal; distinguish billing/collection from earned revenue.
proposal.proof: Prove schedule allocation totals, period recognition replay, modifications and GL reconciliation under approved policy.

proposal.title: Finance risk register
proposal.layout: Scorecards, supplier assessments and market exposures with owner/action/evidence.
proposal.workflow: Explain score model and version; distinguish measured exposure from qualitative assessment.
proposal.proof: Prove score provenance, stale assessment, role-limited changes and mitigation history.

proposal.title: Scenario comparison
proposal.layout: Aligned comparison matrix for equal scope/currency/period with absolute/percentage deltas.
proposal.workflow: Block incompatible baselines or explain conversion; drill into differing drivers and lines.
proposal.proof: Prove consistent denominator, zero base, scenario version preservation and reconciled exports.

proposal.title: Subscription record
proposal.layout: RecordShell: contract, billing history, usage, amendments and audit.
proposal.workflow: Usage uses typed metric/unit/period with correction history; lifecycle actions have impact review.
proposal.proof: Prove duplicate usage, negative/correction policy, mid-cycle change and invoice/revenue links.

proposal.title: New subscription
proposal.layout: Transaction form with customer/plan lookup, price/currency, term, billing cycle and start.
proposal.workflow: Replace raw customer ID; review proration, tax and first invoice date before draft/activation.
proposal.proof: Prove invalid dates, missing plan, tenant-restricted lookup and exact initial billing preview.

proposal.title: Subscription register
proposal.layout: Customer/plan/status/currency/cadence register plus defined MRR/ARR metrics.
proposal.workflow: Distinguish billing from revenue recognition and pause from cancel; batch billing review required.
proposal.proof: Prove proration policy, duplicate billing, scheduled cancellation and metric reconciliation.

proposal.title: Tax rules and withholding
proposal.layout: Jurisdiction/type/effective-date rule register with precedence and calculation preview.
proposal.workflow: Expose authoritative source/version and exemption conditions; no globally applied fixed rates.
proposal.proof: Prove overlapping rules, date applicability, rounding and missing-rule failure using owner-approved cases.

proposal.title: Tax filing summary
proposal.layout: Liability/due-date/status summary by entity and jurisdiction with underlying returns.
proposal.workflow: Differentiate no obligation from missing setup; reconcile to tax ledger and source period.
proposal.proof: Prove overdue logic, timezone/calendar, liability totals and filtered filing links.

proposal.title: Tax filing preparation
proposal.layout: Draft return register and guided input/reconciliation/review/output workflow.
proposal.workflow: Replace technical payload entry as primary UX with labelled business fields; submission status requires acknowledgment.
proposal.proof: Prove period validity, missing source data, rejected preparation and immutable approved version.

proposal.title: Nexus monitoring
proposal.layout: Jurisdiction threshold/measurement dashboard with effective rules and evidence drill-through.
proposal.workflow: Explain sales/transaction basis, exemptions and monitoring date; alert is not automatic legal registration.
proposal.proof: Prove configured threshold boundaries, applicable periods, exclusions and auditable rule updates.

proposal.title: Tax operations
proposal.layout: Specialized jurisdiction versions, certificates, reconciliations, withholding and amendments sections.
proposal.workflow: Preserve published specialized contracts; surface evidence, effective dates and approval separately.
proposal.proof: Prove expired certificate, jurisdiction versioning, amended filing lineage and scoped permission denial.

proposal.title: Tax provision workpapers
proposal.layout: Provision runs, deferred schedules and uncertain positions with methodology and approvals.
proposal.workflow: Show current/deferred components, assumptions and effective rates; no claim of certification from title.
proposal.proof: Prove component reconciliation, missing inputs, sign/rounding and approved journal lineage.

proposal.title: Treasury operations
proposal.layout: Portfolio/transaction register with counterparty, value date, currency, instrument and approval.
proposal.workflow: Map actions to real portfolio/sweep/transfer capabilities; show fees, available funds and settlement status.
proposal.proof: Prove date/currency validity, dual authorization, transfer replay and failed settlement reconciliation.

proposal.title: Working capital programs
proposal.layout: Separate discount offers, supply-chain finance and factoring with cash impact comparison.
proposal.workflow: Explain DSO/DPO/DIO/CCC definitions and offer assumptions; acceptance is a controlled transaction.
proposal.proof: Prove denominator rules, offer expiry, disclosed rates/fees and approval before financial commitment.

proposal.title: Payables review queue
proposal.layout: Bill queue plus selected actual PO/receipt/invoice line comparison.
proposal.workflow: Remove fabricated original-document preview, fixed pagination and implied verification; review variance before payment.
proposal.proof: Prove matching tolerances, attachment absence, selection identity, failed payment recovery and approved-state gating.

proposal.title: Receivables collection queue
proposal.layout: Aging-filtered worklist with invoice/customer inspector, disputes and promises.
proposal.workflow: Replace automatic full-balance ACH receipt with deliberate partial-payment/allocation form; real follow-up history.
proposal.proof: Prove aging boundaries, partial settlement, payment replay, concurrent collector conflict and source links.

proposal.title: Asset overview
proposal.layout: Asset register plus selected asset lifecycle and depreciation schedule.
proposal.workflow: Remove fallback amounts/default cost/location and fixed depreciation period; route registration to canonical asset form.
proposal.proof: Prove valid zero balances, actual asset selection, open-period depreciation and persisted run/journal references.

proposal.title: Banking overview
proposal.layout: Account/currency balances, sync status, unmatched queue and selected reconciliation context.
proposal.workflow: Bind summary to real bank/book data; import through real file validation and route to owned matching workflow.
proposal.proof: Prove bank/ledger balance definitions, duplicate statement handling, stale connection and residual differences.

proposal.title: Budget planning workspace
proposal.layout: Version/scenario matrix with budget/actual/forecast and driver inspector.
proposal.workflow: Remove fictional KPI fallbacks and saved timestamps; bind drivers and fiscal period to persisted draft.
proposal.proof: Prove scenario isolation, save/reload, dirty refetch, signed favorable variance and submission freeze.

proposal.title: Expenses entry hub
proposal.layout: Task navigation into expense reports, policies and supported card/reimbursement flows.
proposal.workflow: Keep existing embedded views but remove duplicate cross-module navigation; one canonical expense model.
proposal.proof: Prove subview deep links, permission filtering and return context from report details.

proposal.title: FX revaluation overview
proposal.layout: Rate provenance, foreign balances, preview impact and run history.
proposal.workflow: Converge with advanced FX workflows; no decorative live-rate or successful-post badges.
proposal.proof: Prove missing/stale rates, currency/date semantics, balanced journal, replay and reversal references.

proposal.title: General ledger
proposal.layout: DataWorkspace: account/period/book/dimension filters, ledger lines and selected-record inspector.
proposal.workflow: Repair missing provider path and non-durable source behavior before enabling posting; show real balances and source journals.
proposal.proof: Prove error states, full-dataset totals, balancing, tenant scope, durable posting/reversal and retained drill-down context.

proposal.title: Intercompany overview
proposal.layout: Entity-pair balances and exceptions with elimination/netting drill-through.
proposal.workflow: Distinguish consolidation elimination from settlement netting; no local-only completed state.
proposal.proof: Prove both-side identifiers, period/book consistency, unmatched counterpart and durable results.

proposal.title: Customer invoice record
proposal.layout: Record/Transaction workspace: invoice header, items, payments/credits, document, related source and audit.
proposal.workflow: Show immutable issued values and explicit settlement/credit lifecycle; retain parent list state and selected ID.
proposal.proof: Prove invalid/foreign ID, partial related-data failure, arithmetic/rounding, payment history and credit balances.

proposal.title: Customer invoice register
proposal.layout: One list toolbar, scoped totals, saved filters, canonical statuses and currency columns.
proposal.workflow: Use one creation/export entry point; totals and export follow applied filters rather than separate capped query.
proposal.proof: Prove more than 250 invoices, mixed currencies, status filters, complete export and intentional line-based creation.

proposal.title: Journal register
proposal.layout: DataWorkspace: lifecycle views, journal totals, author/approver and source.
proposal.workflow: Converge with advanced journal register by contract; separate create, submit, approve, post and reverse.
proposal.proof: Prove lifecycle-specific permissions, state transitions, duplicate prevention and recurrence links.

proposal.proof: Prove all KPI definitions and totals against source, no-data/failed-data distinction, chart table alternative and neutral zero changes.

proposal.proof: Prove due-date context, no-obligation state, missing rules, failed filing dependency and authorized status transitions.

proposal.title: Vendor bill register
proposal.layout: Supplier/date/status/amount register with actual source-document entry and detail access.
proposal.workflow: Align with AP work queue; separate submitted bill data from approval, payment and matching evidence.
proposal.proof: Prove duplicate supplier reference, filtered totals, failed upload, draft correction and approved-record immutability.
